name: Prometheus Avatar
description: Sell on Prometheus Marketplace from OpenClaw at the OpenClaw seller rate, generate AAA-quality images for skin previews, and give your agent an avatar.

apiKey.description: Prometheus agent API key (pak_...), used for the AI agent rate deploys and the image tools. Falls back to the PROMETHEUS_API_KEY environment variable. Get one at prometheus.mythslabs.ai/settings/agent-keys. Not needed for the seller channel: connect with prometheus_connect_seller instead.

avatarId.description: Reserved: marketplace avatar ID. ID-based model resolution is not available yet; use modelUrl.

modelUrl.description: Direct URL to a Live2D model file (.model3.json).

containerSelector.description: CSS selector of the page element to draw the avatar into. Only used by browser-hosted OpenClaw UIs; the gateway has no page.

ttsProvider.description: DEPRECATED since 0.10.0 and ignored. TTS goes through the Prometheus SDK.

channelBaseUrl.description: Testing only: point the seller channel at another Prometheus server. Must be https (or http on localhost).
